headline: Alberta Restricts AI Data Centre Construction and Mandates Orphan Well Funds
summary: Alberta introduced legislation restricting locations for artificial intelligence data centres amid local backlash and requiring oil and gas operators to set aside funding to prevent abandoned wells.
why: Rapid data centre construction poses rising strains on power grids and cooling resources across North America, prompting regional regulatory limits.

impacts.name: Data Center Infrastructure
impacts.why: New geographic limits constrain AI data centre deployment and expansion options across the province.
